approvalBasis: User approved this mockup with “perfect” after requesting the open-fold stack, Duolingo-like colors, single circle, and name X.
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. A sophisticated yet joyful native iOS daily puzzle app named exactly 'X'. Portrait 402x874 equivalent fullbleed screenshot, no device frame. The user rejected neon/glassy UI and now wants Duolingo-level craft, delightful color and rounded playful UI elements, with an OPEN FOLD card stack. Original design, do not copy Duolingo owl, mascot, logo or screen. Bright clean very pale sky-blue background #EFF7FF, dark navy text, bold rounded SF Pro Rounded typography throughout. Native iPhone 9:41 status bar. Header top left is just a beautiful big navy 'X' with small 'Your daily brain break.' beneath, right small six-dot daily progress and '0 of 6'. Main scene in center is an OPEN FOLD / ACCORDION deck of six puzzle cards. The deck is physically open: several rounded rectangular colorful card faces fan upward behind the active front card as hinged leaves of an open wallet or accordion, 3D perspective tilted slightly backwards, not a messy flat pile. The bright coral rear card exposes a 'Fourfold' label; sunny yellow card exposes 'Little Cryptic'; mint-green layer exposes 'Ballpark'. The active FRONT CARD is bold vivid sky blue, with 22pt rounded corners, a thick deeper blue lower rim giving tactile Duolingo-like button depth, restrained light specular edge, no glow. Title 'Deep Cut' is 32pt bold rounded white at top left, small 7-dot progress row beneath; center a beautiful native-looking abstract trivia preview formed from three white rounded answer rows each with a chunky colored circular score chip at right, text 'Obvious' with 10, 'Clever' with 50, 'Unexpected' with 100, little geometric four-point spark next to the rare answer. Real functional game preview, not character artwork. Bottom of blue card 'Go for the unexpected.' in bold rounded white 22pt and '7 rounds · 25 seconds' below in white. NO separate play button; entire card is tappable. Generous white space around folded deck. Small instruction below 'Swipe to unfold. Tap to play.' with a tiny native chevron. Bottom center has exactly ONE circular navy navigation control 62pt with a white SF-symbol-style 3-layer stack icon and a slightly brighter blue lower edge. There is NO tab bar, NO Today/Archive/You row, NO other buttons at bottom. One little 'Your collection' text under central circle if needed. All six cards form a cohesive centered hinged open-fold stack, vibrant friendly flat color with satisfying soft tactile depth. Premium clarity and deliberate geometry, gameful without childish clutter. No neon, glass, fog, gradients as page background, serif fonts, marketing hero, button rows, brand mascots or fabricated stats. A real beautiful Apple-native mobile game collection screenshot.
